Izuzetno ljubazni i profesionalni!

Very professional medical service. Good contact, comfortable hotel's visit on the same day, absolutely no problem with anything - medical problem solved, payment directly via insurance company. That is, what tourists need during holiday (and tour leaders during work ;) ).

Regards
Piotr Ciesielski - tour leader
Medical Vranes, thank you for your high level services, quick replies and professional doctors instructions. I contacted Medical Vranes while vacation in Tivat.
Jako ažurno osoblje. Lekar je bio jako pristojan  i rad da odgovori na sve nedoumice i posavetuje za dalje lečenje. Sve prepkruke
Very good and fast medical care and friendly staff.
Vrhunska usluga. Profesionalan i ljudski pristup. Veliko hvala za sve,
Sve pohvale!!!
Savršena brzina reagovanja, stručnost i ljubaznost krasi ovaj medicinski tim.❤️
Brzo, efikasno i profesionalno. Sve na jednom mestu.

Došli na odmor u Bar iz Srbije, dete ujeo insekt, imao reakciju, preko osiguranja stupila u kontakt sa Vraneš klinikom, brzo reagovanje, maksimalno izlaženje u susret, ljubazno osoblje i rešen problem. Sve pohvale!
Zadovoljni smo uslugom, došla je doktorka u smeštaj vrlo brzo od momenta kada smo zatražili pomoć i odmah je odredila terapiju za moju decu. Sve najbolje!

Veoma profesionalni, organizovani, predusretljivi i ekspeditivni! Sarađuju sa raznim osiguravajućih kućama. Organizuju kućne posete lekara za kovid pozitivne turiste u vrlo kratkom roku. Lekari su ljubazni, kompetentni, detaljni i dobro opremljeni svim priborom potrebnim za kompletan pregled. Daju preciznu dijagnostiku i sveobuhvatnu terapiju i savete. Sve pohvale i preporuke!

Great experience with Medical vranes team! Everyone want to avoid to have this kind of service during vacation, but in case in happens (as it happened to us), it is nice feeling to have someone to really support you in such a situation! Everything went very well and fast, our inssurance connected us with them and they organized everything and supported us during whole process. Big thank you to the team!
